svg.title: DeckMe!
svg.desc: DeckMe! — Flashcards for desktop, web and mobile. An Anki-inspired flashcard app: turn notes into structured decks with an LLM prompt, then study with zen mode, a pomodoro timer and progress charts. Native builds for Windows, Linux and Android, plus a web app. Stack: Tauri 2, Capacitor, React, TypeScript, MUI. Apr 2026 → Oct 2026, public, novakamiii/DeckMe.
